---
params:
  author: "Benjamin Black"
  picture: "assets/cv_new.png"
title: '`r sprintf("%s - Curriculum Vitæ", params[["author"]])`'
author: '`r params[["author"]]`'
output:
  pagedown::html_resume:
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
    css: "cv.css"
knit: pagedown::chrome_print
---

```{r}
#| include: false

# Load config
cv_config <- yaml::read_yaml("config.yaml")

# Set knitr options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  results = "asis",
  eval = TRUE,
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE, # Don't include messages in output (but they show in console)
  error = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE # Don't include warnings in output (but they show in console)
)

# Load functions for each section
invisible(sapply(
  X = list.files(
    path = file.path("R"),
    pattern = "\\.R$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  FUN = source
))
```

# Aside

```{r}
#| out.extra: 'style="width: 226px;" id="picture"'
knitr::include_graphics(params[["picture"]])
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Display data source information (messages only show in console, not in output)
message("🚀 CV Rendering Started")
message(
  "📡 Data Source: Remote GitHub repository - ",
  cv_config$cv_data_repo,
  " (branch: ",
  cv_config$cv_data_branch,
  ")"
)
message("📄 Fallback: Local files in data/sections/ (if GitHub unavailable)")
message(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""))
```

```{r}
# Print contents of all sections using remote GitHub functions
# Comment out sections that you do not want to include
cat(
  contact_section(
    github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
    branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch
  ),
  skills_section(
    github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
    branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch
  ),
  languages_section(
    github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
    branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch
  ),
  title_section(author = params[["author"]]),
  profil_section(
    github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
    branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch
  ),
  education_section(
    github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
    branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE,
    include_sections = c("thesis", "awards")
  ),
  experience_section(
    github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
    branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE,
    use_bullets = FALSE,
    reverse_order = FALSE,
    max_entries = cv_config$max_entries$experience
  ),
  workshop_section(
    github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
    branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE,
    colour = "#333333"
  ),
  awards_section(
    github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
    branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch,
    page_break_after = TRUE,
    colour = "#333333"
  ),
  articles_section(
    github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
    branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE,
    colour = "#333333",
    max_entries = cv_config$max_entries$articles
  ),
  presentations_section(
    github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
    branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch,
    page_break_after = FALSE,
    colour = "#333333",
    max_entries = cv_config$max_entries$presentations
  ),
  # poster_section(
  #   github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo,
  #   branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch,
  #   page_break_after = FALSE,
  #   colour = "#333333"
  # ),
  # packages_section(github_repo = cv_config$cv_data_repo, branch = cv_config$cv_data_branch, page_break_after = FALSE),
  disclaimer_section(text = NULL),
  sep = "\n"
)
```
